programme.title: Ghost Adventures S1 ep 1
programme.desc: A clairvoyant repairman fearful of ghosts is forced to help them cross over so they can leave him in peace. On his journey of helping these ghosts with their unfinished businesses, he ends up getting into trouble with their families, friends and the community they are all living in. Will he be able to get these ghosts and their love ones, at the same time face his fear of them?

programme.title: Sari Saring Sine: Pik Pak Boom
programme.desc: Pik Pak Boom is a 1988 Filipino anthology comedy film directed by Leroy Salvador and starring Herbert Bautista, Lea Salonga, Lilet, Bing Loyzaga, Regine Velasquez, and Dingdong Avanzado. The film consists of two segments: \"Manyika\" (lit. 'Doll') and \"Banana Q\".

programme.title: Ghost Adventures S1 ep 1
programme.desc: A clairvoyant repairman fearful of ghosts is forced to help them cross over so they can leave him in peace. On his journey of helping these ghosts with their unfinished businesses, he ends up getting into trouble with their families, friends and the community they are all living in. Will he be able to get these ghosts and their love ones, at the same time face his fear of them?

programme.title: Afterlife ep 4
programme.desc: Peter, a deceased Filipino-Chinese businessman, returns as a ghost and is bonded to Romy, a Filipino caretaker of a Chinese temple. He sets out to let his family know the whole truth through Romy.

programme.title: The Last Woman Standing ep 12
programme.desc: After the death of his wife, a man's four mistresses compete against one another to become his next wife, as his wife's ghost continues to haunt them.

programme.title: The Mysterious Case of Bea Montenegro ep 7
programme.desc: A Sari-Sari Original Series. Hot off the heels from her last cold case, investigative journalist Christine Del Mundo (Maui Taylor) is back with a brand new cold case. This time, it involves actress Bea Montenegro, whose death has only brought forth one suspect - a fellow model who suffers from face blindness.

programme.title: Kurdapya ep 3
programme.desc: Kurdapya tells the story of long-lost twins, KURING \u0026 DAPHNE. They meet after a strange accident and discover that they lead extremely different lives. Kuring grew up with the cruel extended family in the province while Daphne is an undervalued publishing executive in the city. Both women want to get out of their current realities, so they decide to switch lives by pretending to be each other.

programme.title: Nogomet – Copa Sudamericana: Finale
programme.desc: Lanús i Atlético Mineiro odmjerit će snage 22. studenoga 2025. u finalu Copa Sudamericane. Tko će slaviti na stadionu Defensores del Chaco\ni osvojiti prestižnu titulu? Susret počinje u 21:00.

programme.title: Baseball – Mlb: World Series G2

programme.title: Nfl: Atlanta – La Rams
programme.desc: Momčad Atlanta Falconsa odmjerit će snage s Los Angeles Ramsima u susretu NFL-a. Tko će slaviti? Susret počinje u 02:15.

programme.title: One Žive Za Nogomet
programme.desc: Emisija o nogometnim entuzijastkinjama koje usprkos tome što njihovi klubovi ne igraju u višim rangovima natjecanja, predano i s puno elana pristupaju svakoj utakmici.

programme.title: Sport Bez Granica
programme.desc: Uđite u svijet sporta uz našu emisiju i saznajte najnovije vijesti i zanimljivosti!

programme.title: Hokej Na Ledu – Nhl: Washington – Ny Rangers
programme.desc: Washington Capitals i New York Rangers odmjerit će snage 31. prosinca 2025. Tko će slaviti u ovom NHL susretu na ledu Capital One Arene? Susret počinje u 18:30.

programme.title: Košarka – Liga Prvaka: Levice – Wurzburg

programme.title: Baseball – Mlb: Playoff
programme.desc: Sezona 2025. počinje s velikim očekivanjima: mogu li Houston Astrosi vratiti titulu? Hoće li Shohei Ohtani ponovno dominirati na oba kraja terena?

programme.title: Nfl: Tbd

programme.title: Dune
programme.desc: Paul, the young scion of House Atreides faces troubling visions of the future. Meanwhile, his family fights to gain control over Arrakis, the only source of the valuable spice melange.

programme.title: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: Lara Croft undertakes a dangerous journey by travelling to the last known location of her missing father, to unravel the truth behind his mysterious disappearance.

programme.title: Born to Fight
programme.desc: Dan Barnes, a former professional boxer, takes up the responsibility to coach Matthew Miller, a teenager who is repeatedly bullied by a school boxing champion and his friends.

programme.title: Act of Valor
programme.desc: An elite team of US Navy SEALs is tasked with rescuing a kidnapped CIA operative. However, things become complicated when they come across a much larger global threat in the process.

programme.title: Stars!
programme.desc: The host sheds light on various popular individuals from different walks of life and highlights their individual journeys to stardom.

programme.title: StreetDance 2
programme.desc: After an embarrassing defeat, a street dancer, Ash, assembles the best dancers from all across the world for another round against the Invincible crew.

programme.title: Southpaw
programme.desc: After a devastating accident shatters his world, a once-celebrated champion boxer spirals into a destructive abyss. Subsequently, he decides to fight for his daughter and revive his fading career.

programme.title: 300: Rise of an Empire
programme.desc: Xerxes, seeking revenge for his father's death, declares war on Greece. As a result, Themistocles, the Athenian admiral, is compelled to form an alliance with Sparta to protect Athens.

programme.title: The November Man
programme.desc: Peter, a former CIA officer, is assigned the task of protecting a valuable witness, Alice, who has secret information about a Russian presidential candidate.

programme.title: Rush Hour 2
programme.desc: Detective James Carter and Chief Inspector Lee return to action after a bomb explosion at the US Embassy in Hong Kong.

programme.title: Dune
programme.desc: Paul, the young scion of House Atreides faces troubling visions of the future. Meanwhile, his family fights to gain control over Arrakis, the only source of the valuable spice melange.

programme.title: Kong: Skull Island
programme.desc: A crew that reaches Skull Island to map it, is attacked by a humongous ape. The survivors then regroup to find out more about the ape, the island's natives and underground monsters.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible Rogue Nation
programme.desc: Following IMF's assimilation into the CIA, Ethan Hunt and his team face a new challenge from the Syndicate, an international rogue group determined to destroy their organisation.

programme.title: Ghost Rider: Spirit of Vengeance
programme.desc: A French monk seeks out the Ghost Rider, a superpowered antihero, for help in protecting a young boy who is being pursued by the Devil and his minions.

programme.title: Stuart Little
programme.desc: Upon getting adopted by the Littles, Stuart, a mouse, is unwelcomed by his new brother George. So, when Stuart begins to feel low the family helps him find his real parents.

programme.title: Black Adam
programme.desc: After being granted the divine power of the Egyptian Gods and spending almost 5000 years in a guardhouse, Black Adam is freed and decides to unleash his style of justice on the world.
